WITH MostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT Id AS UserId
    FROM users
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
FilteredPosts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Score
    FROM posts p
    JOIN MostInfluentialUser miu ON p.OwnerUserId = miu.UserId
),
HighScoringPosts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_high_score
    FROM FilteredPosts
    WHERE Score > 50
),
AllPostsByUser AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM FilteredPosts
)
SELECT 
    CAST(HighScoringPosts.count_high_score AS REAL) / AllPostsByUser.total_count * 100 AS percentage_high_score
FROM HighScoringPosts, AllPostsByUser
